programme.title: DIPLOMAT'S ARCHIVE: HIDDEN STORIES
programme.desc:
As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet?
"Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries.
Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: SMARTBIZ ACCELERATORS(30분)
programme.desc:
Along with the strengthened manufacturing capabilities of various countries all around the world, "Smart Factory" has garnered a lot of attention in the global market. And the government has unveiled and promoted a roadmap "Manufacturing Innovation 3.0," as part of an effort to enhance the competitiveness of the domestic manufacturing sector. Moreover, a domestic major company Samsung Electronics has provided a smart factory solution in order to boost mutual growth with small and medium-sized businesses. SmartBiz Accelerators introduces a variety of domestic small and medium-sized companies that have achieved continuous growth based on the smart factory project provided by Samsung Electronics as well as gives information on the technological competitiveness and the outlook for the companies in the global market.

programme.title: COUNTRYSIDE ESCAPE
programme.desc:
A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea.
More than just a getaway, the show follows the group as they unwind, enjoy local food, and experience rural life amid unfamiliar surroundings, bringing generations and nationalities together through shared laughter and connection.
Through a fresh and unique perspective, the show offers a new look at Korea’s familiar yet unexpected countryside, delivering a refreshing experience for viewers.
Bringing the “chon-cance” trend, which has gained attention among young people and on social media, to television, the show creates a feel-good story of healing and connection that everyone can relate to.※ VOD service is currently not available due to copyright issues.

programme.title: SHOW K-POP [L]
programme.desc:
Music has crossed borders, but the charts are still bound within them. A stage in Seoul and lightsticks in Brazil, early-morning streaming in Manila and fan accounts in Paris. What moves K-POP today are the people around the world listening to the same song at the very same moment. “SHOW K-POP” is the one and only global chart show for everyone. And it all begins on October 19, 2026. Three Promises OF THE FANSThe main characters of the chart are the fans. Through TikTok and Mubeat, viewers step right into the broadcast. Every vote you cast and every comment you leave will help shape this music chart show. We’ll build this together with the fans, and complete it together with the fans.BY THE FANSStars are made by the fans. Every episode features at least one rookie group, giving you the chance to get to know the names the world has yet to know. We’ll create the moments when an artist you’ve just discovered becomes your ultimate bias.
FOR THE FANLowering language barriers and raising the excitement. This is a show that’s conducted entirely in English from start to finish. There’s no need to wait for subtitles or rely on translations. We’ll bring the stories fans are most curious about in a way that resonates with fans around the world. The one and only global standard chart show, made together with K-POP fans worldwide. Premieres October 19, 2026 | LIVE every Monday at 6 PM (KST)Please catch the reruns!Broadcast Schedule (KST)- Monday: 6:00 PM (Live Broadcast / Premiere)- Friday: 12:50 PM, 6:00 PM- Saturday: 6:00 AM- Sunday: 10:50 AM, 8:50 PM- Monday: 2:00 AMThere is no on-demand replay available. Please catch one of the scheduled rebroadcasts.

programme.title: COUNTRYSIDE ESCAPE
programme.desc:
A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea.
More than just a getaway, the show follows the group as they unwind, enjoy local food, and experience rural life amid unfamiliar surroundings, bringing generations and nationalities together through shared laughter and connection.
Through a fresh and unique perspective, the show offers a new look at Korea’s familiar yet unexpected countryside, delivering a refreshing experience for viewers.
Bringing the “chon-cance” trend, which has gained attention among young people and on social media, to television, the show creates a feel-good story of healing and connection that everyone can relate to.※ VOD service is currently not available due to copyright issues.

programme.title: DIPLOMAT'S ARCHIVE: HIDDEN STORIES
programme.desc:
As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet?
"Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries.
Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: SMARTBIZ ACCEL 2(10분)
programme.desc:
Along with the strengthened manufacturing capabilities of various countries all around the world, "Smart Factory" has garnered a lot of attention in the global market. And the government has unveiled and promoted a roadmap "Manufacturing Innovation 3.0," as part of an effort to enhance the competitiveness of the domestic manufacturing sector. Moreover, a domestic major company Samsung Electronics has provided a smart factory solution in order to boost mutual growth with small and medium-sized businesses. SmartBiz Accelerators introduces a variety of domestic small and medium-sized companies that have achieved continuous growth based on the smart factory project provided by Samsung Electronics as well as gives information on the technological competitiveness and the outlook for the companies in the global market.

programme.title: BEAUTY ON AND OFF
programme.desc:
K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing.
So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products.
Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”.
Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE C
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.desc:
Music has crossed borders, but the charts are still bound within them. A stage in Seoul and lightsticks in Brazil, early-morning streaming in Manila and fan accounts in Paris. Every vote you cast and every comment you leave will help shape this music chart show. We’ll build this together with the fans, and complete it together with the fans.BY THE FANSStars are made by the fans. Every episode features at least one rookie group, giving you the chance to get to know the names the world has yet to know. We’ll create the moments when an artist you’ve just discovered becomes your ultimate bias.
FOR THE FANLowering language barriers and raising the excitement. This is a show that’s conducted entirely in English from start to finish. There’s no need to wait for subtitles or rely on translations. We’ll bring the stories fans are most curious about in a way that resonates with fans around the world. The one and only global standard chart show, made together with K-POP fans worldwide. programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: SHOW K-POP [R]
programme.desc:
Music has crossed borders, but the charts are still bound within them. A stage in Seoul and lightsticks in Brazil, early-morning streaming in Manila and fan accounts in Paris. What moves K-POP today are the people around the world listening to the same song at the very same moment. “SHOW K-POP” is the one and only global chart show for everyone. And it all begins on October 19, 2026. Three Promises OF THE FANSThe main characters of the chart are the fans. Through TikTok and Mubeat, viewers step right into the broadcast. Every vote you cast and every comment you leave will help shape this music chart show. We’ll build this together with the fans, and complete it together with the fans.BY THE FANSStars are made by the fans. Every episode features at least one rookie group, giving you the chance to get to know the names the world has yet to know. We’ll create the moments when an artist you’ve just discovered becomes your ultimate bias.
FOR THE FANLowering language barriers and raising the excitement. This is a show that’s conducted entirely in English from start to finish. There’s no need to wait for subtitles or rely on translations. We’ll bring the stories fans are most curious about in a way that resonates with fans around the world. The one and only global standard chart show, made together with K-POP fans worldwide. programme.title: DIPLOMAT'S ARCHIVE: HIDDEN STORIES
programme.desc:
As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet?
"Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries.
Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: BEAUTY ON AND OFF
programme.desc:
K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing.
So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products.
Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”.
Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: DIPLOMAT'S ARCHIVE: HIDDEN STORIES
programme.desc:
As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet?
"Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries.
Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: BEAUTY ON AND OFF
programme.desc:
K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing.
So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products.
Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”.
Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: COUNTRYSIDE ESCAPE
programme.desc:
A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea.
More than just a getaway, the show follows the group as they unwind, enjoy local food, and experience rural life amid unfamiliar surroundings, bringing generations and nationalities together through shared laughter and connection.
Through a fresh and unique perspective, the show offers a new look at Korea’s familiar yet unexpected countryside, delivering a refreshing experience for viewers.
Bringing the “chon-cance” trend, which has gained attention among young people and on social media, to television, the show creates a feel-good story of healing and connection that everyone can relate to.※ VOD service is currently not available due to copyright issues.

programme.title: SMARTBIZ ACCELERATORS(30분)
programme.desc:
Along with the strengthened manufacturing capabilities of various countries all around the world, "Smart Factory" has garnered a lot of attention in the global market. And the government has unveiled and promoted a roadmap "Manufacturing Innovation 3.0," as part of an effort to enhance the competitiveness of the domestic manufacturing sector. Moreover, a domestic major company Samsung Electronics has provided a smart factory solution in order to boost mutual growth with small and medium-sized businesses. SmartBiz Accelerators introduces a variety of domestic small and medium-sized companies that have achieved continuous growth based on the smart factory project provided by Samsung Electronics as well as gives information on the technological competitiveness and the outlook for the companies in the global market.

programme.title: COUNTRYSIDE ESCAPE
programme.desc:
A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea.
More than just a getaway, the show follows the group as they unwind, enjoy local food, and experience rural life amid unfamiliar surroundings, bringing generations and nationalities together through shared laughter and connection.
Through a fresh and unique perspective, the show offers a new look at Korea’s familiar yet unexpected countryside, delivering a refreshing experience for viewers.
Bringing the “chon-cance” trend, which has gained attention among young people and on social media, to television, the show creates a feel-good story of healing and connection that everyone can relate to.※ VOD service is currently not available due to copyright issues.

programme.title: DIPLOMAT'S ARCHIVE: HIDDEN STORIES
programme.desc:
As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet?
"Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries.
Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: BEAUTY ON AND OFF
programme.desc:
K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing.
So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products.
Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”.
Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE C
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE C
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: DIPLOMAT'S ARCHIVE: HIDDEN STORIES
programme.desc:
As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet?
"Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries.
Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: DIPLOMAT'S ARCHIVE: HIDDEN STORIES
programme.desc:
As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet?
"Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries.
Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: BEAUTY ON AND OFF
programme.desc:
K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing.
So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products.
Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”.
Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: TALK ROOM
programme.desc:
What is the true strength of the K-people leading the K-Wave? We invite the most talked-about figures—those who influence not just Korea but the world—into our studio for intimate one-on-one conversations. Through their stories, the secrets behind overcoming failure and achieving success, and even private small talk, we uncover what makes them extraordinary.
When you listen to someone’s story, you enter their world. In this time of dialogue with the most Korean yet most global K-people, we step into the K-Universe.

programme.title: WITH SCIENCE, WE LIVE
programme.desc: Humanity has learned from the past, transcended the present, and dreamed of the future."With Science, We Live"explores the frontiers of science alongside some of the world’s leading thinkers, offering insights into what lies ahead and uncovering new possibilities.In an era of rapid change, where are we headed?As we navigate between the vast universe and the smallness of human existence, we reconsider the direction we must take.Now, in this very moment, we imagine the future shaped by our choices—and move forward toward it.

programme.title: SMARTBIZ ACCELERATORS(30분)
programme.desc:
Along with the strengthened manufacturing capabilities of various countries all around the world, "Smart Factory" has garnered a lot of attention in the global market. And the government has unveiled and promoted a roadmap "Manufacturing Innovation 3.0," as part of an effort to enhance the competitiveness of the domestic manufacturing sector. Moreover, a domestic major company Samsung Electronics has provided a smart factory solution in order to boost mutual growth with small and medium-sized businesses. SmartBiz Accelerators introduces a variety of domestic small and medium-sized companies that have achieved continuous growth based on the smart factory project provided by Samsung Electronics as well as gives information on the technological competitiveness and the outlook for the companies in the global market.
#SmartBizAccelerators #ArirangTV #smartfactory #smartfactoryproject #competitiveness_of_manufacturing #strengthening_competitiveness_of_SMEs #expanding_into_overseas_markets #growth_into_globalbusiness

programme.title: COUNTRYSIDE ESCAPE
programme.desc:
A reality show that captures the growing trend of “chon-cance”—a countryside vacation enjoyed by foreigners living in cities across Korea.
More than just a getaway, the show follows the group as they unwind, enjoy local food, and experience rural life amid unfamiliar surroundings, bringing generations and nationalities together through shared laughter and connection.
Through a fresh and unique perspective, the show offers a new look at Korea’s familiar yet unexpected countryside, delivering a refreshing experience for viewers.
Bringing the “chon-cance” trend, which has gained attention among young people and on social media, to television, the show creates a feel-good story of healing and connection that everyone can relate to.※ VOD service is currently not available due to copyright issues.

programme.title: SHOW K-POP [L]
programme.desc:
Music has crossed borders, but the charts are still bound within them. A stage in Seoul and lightsticks in Brazil, early-morning streaming in Manila and fan accounts in Paris. What moves K-POP today are the people around the world listening to the same song at the very same moment. “SHOW K-POP” is the one and only global chart show for everyone. And it all begins on October 19, 2026. Three Promises OF THE FANSThe main characters of the chart are the fans. Through TikTok and Mubeat, viewers step right into the broadcast. Every vote you cast and every comment you leave will help shape this music chart show. We’ll build this together with the fans, and complete it together with the fans.BY THE FANSStars are made by the fans. Every episode features at least one rookie group, giving you the chance to get to know the names the world has yet to know. We’ll create the moments when an artist you’ve just discovered becomes your ultimate bias.
FOR THE FANLowering language barriers and raising the excitement. This is a show that’s conducted entirely in English from start to finish. There’s no need to wait for subtitles or rely on translations. We’ll bring the stories fans are most curious about in a way that resonates with fans around the world. The one and only global standard chart show, made together with K-POP fans worldwide. Premieres October 19, 2026 | LIVE every Monday at 6 PM (KST)Please catch the reruns!Broadcast Schedule (KST)- Monday: 6:00 PM (Live Broadcast / Premiere)- Friday: 12:50 PM, 6:00 PM- Saturday: 6:00 AM- Sunday: 10:50 AM, 8:50 PM- Monday: 2:00 AMThere is no on-demand replay available. Please catch one of the scheduled rebroadcasts.

programme.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE B
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: BEAUTY ON AND OFF
programme.desc:
K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing.
So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products.
Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”.
Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE C
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

The one and only global standard chart show, made together with K-POP fans worldwide. programme.title: EXPLORING KOREAN LITERATURE C
programme.desc: 2021 Exploring Korean Literature There is a growing interest in Korean literature among readers from around the world and so we bring Korean classics to Korean modern literature to viewers in this special series under three themes. What They’ve Read Well-known TV personalities read three translated works of Korean literature that have recently received attention. Kim Soom's novel "One Left", brings the comfort women issue to the forefront of the literary world, and her book is recited and discussed by Darcy Paquet, a translator and essayist for the film "Parasite," and translator and essayist Colin Marshall, Italian architect Simone Carena, and fashion designer Shin Ji-hye. The novel was published in the U.S. in September 2020 and a second book print was released this year. Cho Nam-Joo's novel "Kim Jiyoung, Born 1982" has been translated into 25 languages and is recited by TV personality Daniel Hicks (UK), Carlos Gorito (Brazil), YouTuber Sarah Mack (USA) and singer Punita (India) who share their thoughts about the book. Howon, a member of the boy band, W24, recites passages from Kim Young-ha's novel "Diary of a Murderer" and gives commentary. Living to Tell a Story This documentary features Korean writers whose works are not only popular in Korea but also overseas. In episode 1, poet Kim Yi-deum, the Winner of the National Translation Award and the Lucien Stryk Award for her collection of poems, "Hysteria," as well as Korean novelists Kim Cho-Yup and Kim Yeon-su appear to talk about the creative process and how they carry out research before writing a novel. In Episode 2, novelist Yun Ko-Eun, the winner of the Crime Fiction in Translation Dagger award for her book, "The Disaster Tourist", and novelist Ha Seong-nan and poet Jin Eun-young explain what they were trying to convey to readers through their works. In Episode 3, novelist Hwang Sok-young, whose works are mostly inspired by his own experience of living in modern Korean society, tells the story of his life and literary journey. A Word Depicted in Stories The cultural characteristics in Korean literature that encompasses Korean classics to modern novels are highlighted on this show. Six episodes with different themes ranging from female poets in classical literature, makeup culture, wine and arts, tea ceremony, pets, and a literary discussion forum will begin airing on November 5th. -->

programme.title: SHOW K-POP [R]
programme.desc:
Music has crossed borders, but the charts are still bound within them. A stage in Seoul and lightsticks in Brazil, early-morning streaming in Manila and fan accounts in Paris. We’ll build this together with the fans, and complete it together with the fans.BY THE FANSStars are made by the fans. The one and only global standard chart show, made together with K-POP fans worldwide. programme.title: DIPLOMAT'S ARCHIVE: HIDDEN STORIES
programme.desc:
As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet?
"Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries.
Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.

programme.title: BEAUTY ON AND OFF
programme.desc:
K-Beauty is loved all around the world, but choosing the “right” product isn’t always easy. With so many reviews out there, it can sometimes feel even more confusing.
So two male idols hit the streets themselves! Still new to the world of beauty, they meet everyday Koreans— people who are true “beauty experts” in their daily lives, each with their own routines and must-have products.
Inspired by the recommendations they hear on the street, the two idols try the products themselves, sharing honest reviews and comparing their different tastes as they discover what works best for them. Step by step, their experiences and notes come together, eventually forming their very own special “beauty book”.
Join two idols on their honest and fun journey as they explore and discover the world of K-Beauty together!

programme.title: SHOW K-POP [R]
programme.desc:
Music has crossed borders, but the charts are still bound within them. A stage in Seoul and lightsticks in Brazil, early-morning streaming in Manila and fan accounts in Paris. What moves K-POP today are the people around the world listening to the same song at the very same moment. “SHOW K-POP” is the one and only global chart show for everyone. And it all begins on October 19, 2026. Three Promises OF THE FANSThe main characters of the chart are the fans. Through TikTok and Mubeat, viewers step right into the broadcast. Every vote you cast and every comment you leave will help shape this music chart show. We’ll build this together with the fans, and complete it together with the fans.BY THE FANSStars are made by the fans. Every episode features at least one rookie group, giving you the chance to get to know the names the world has yet to know. We’ll create the moments when an artist you’ve just discovered becomes your ultimate bias.
FOR THE FANLowering language barriers and raising the excitement. This is a show that’s conducted entirely in English from start to finish. There’s no need to wait for subtitles or rely on translations. We’ll bring the stories fans are most curious about in a way that resonates with fans around the world. The one and only global standard chart show, made together with K-POP fans worldwide. programme.title: DIPLOMAT'S ARCHIVE: HIDDEN STORIES
programme.desc:
As of April 2025, S. Korea has established diplomatic relations with a total of 194 countries. Among them are countries that have had ties and exchanges with Korea for hundreds of years. With such long-standing relationships with so many nations, might there be fascinating hidden stories between Korea and the rest of the world that we don’t know yet?
"Diplomat’s Archives: Hidden Stories" begins with this very question. Together with foreign embassies in Korea, the series uncovers and sheds light on meaningful yet lesser-known stories between Korea and other countries.
Through this, we aim to reaffirm the deep friendships that have been built over time, highlight how countries are interconnected—bilaterally and multilaterally— and emphasize the importance of cooperation on the global stage today.
